ei.title: Practice 02 — '보통'이고 싶은 욕구와 개성에 대한 갈망
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: We all desire to feel that we are 'normal,' that we fit in and are accepted by others, that we are one of the crowd. Put another way, we generally avoid being regarded as 'being difficult to deal with' or 'not being part of the crowd.' That is, we don't want to appear odd, strange, or anti-social in any way. It may be true that a few eccentrics might deliberately cultivate personal idiosyncracies in order to attract attention, but generally their ultimate goal is to be accepted (even if only by a small collection of admirers) and not regarded as complete social outcasts. However, while the yearning to be accepted and to belong is strong, we strain equally towards being recognized as individuals, and to being thought of as personally significant. Even if in only a minor sense, we wish to stand out from the crowd and not merely blend in with it. We would like our unique contributions to be acknowledged and we want our identities to be honoured as having some special significance in the world. We want to be visible and believed in. We don't want to be overlooked or ignored, as if we weren't there. It's not that we necessarily wish to be famous, or some kind of celebrity (although apparently, many of us wish to be), it's more that we want to avoid invisibility. In no matter how small a way, and to no matter how few people, we want to feel just a little bit special.

❌ ③ merely: 'not merely blend in' — 동사 blend를 꾸미는 부사. 정상

det.tip: appear + 형용사 보어. appear odd(O) / appear oddly(X). 감각동사(appear, seem, look)는 형용사를 보어로 쓴다.

det.korean: ① reluctantly → deliberately: 괴짜들은 관심을 끌려고 '의도적으로' 특이성을 키운다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① reluctantly(마지못해) → deliberately(의도적으로): 괴짜들이 관심을 끌려고 특이성을 키우는 것은 '의도적인' 행위. 마지못해(reluctantly)는 정반대 ← 정답
❌ ② recognized(인정받는): 개인으로 인정받으려 애씀 — 적절
❌ ③ merely(단지): 단지 섞여 들기만 원하지 않음 — 적절
❌ ④ overlooked(간과되는): 간과되고 싶지 않음 — 적절
det.tip: in order to attract attention(관심을 끌려고) → deliberately(의도적으로). reluctantly는 의도와 모순.

questions.passage: We all desire to feel that we are 'normal,' that we fit in and are accepted by others, that we are one of the crowd. Put another way, we generally avoid being regarded as 'being difficult to deal with' or 'not being part of the crowd.' That is, we don't want to appear odd, strange, or anti-social in any way. However, while the yearning to be accepted and to belong is strong, we strain equally towards being recognized as individuals, and to being thought of as personally significant. Even if in only a minor sense, we wish to stand out from the crowd and not merely blend in with it. We don't want to be overlooked or ignored, as if we weren't there. It's not that we necessarily wish to be famous, or some kind of celebrity (although apparently, many of us wish to be), it's more that we want to avoid invisibility. In no matter how small a way, and to no matter how few people, we want to feel just a little bit special.

우리말: 우리는 무리에서 돋보이기를 바란다.
[조건] (1) crowd, from, out, stand, the, to, we, wish를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: we wish to(우리는 ~하기를 바란다) stand out(돋보이다) from the crowd(무리에서)
det.analysis:
구문 분석: we(주어) + wish to(~하기를 바라다) + stand out(두드러지다/돋보이다) + from the crowd(무리로부터). 'stand out from ~'은 '~에서 두드러지다'라는 뜻의 구동사.

단어 순서: we → wish → to → stand → out → from → the → crowd (8단어).
det.tip: wish to + 동사원형 = ~하기를 바라다. stand out from the crowd = 무리에서 돋보이다(↔ blend in).
